label: GO WITH CONDITIONS
call: Keep core Taiseel search and basic land/property discovery free to the public. Build a trusted, current marketplace in a defined Kigali launch market, then earn revenue from professional partners through qualified leads, clearly labelled promotion and useful business tools.

why.point: The public user creates the marketplace network; partner outcomes are what businesses pay for.
A qualified enquiry is more valuable than a generic banner impression. Define lead quality, response time and attribution.
The marketplace's long-term asset is trusted information, usage and repeat partner relationships, not paid ranking.

minority.quote: All eight seats endorsed Option B, five with amendments.
minority.would_have_to_be_true: The model fails if free public search does not create repeat use or if partner leads do not generate repeat payment.

next_steps.action: Make free public search and basic land/property discovery the fixed product principle.
Choose one Kigali inventory segment and define listing verification, freshness and user-contact standards.
Pilot one paid partner offer with agents or developers, measure lead quality and partner renewal before adding banks and other services.

kill_criteria: Do not scale spend or partner inventory if seekers cannot find current relevant listings, qualified enquiries do not lead to partner renewal, or data quality and privacy cannot be maintained.
conditions: Public search and basic discovery remain free.
Start with current, verifiable supply in a bounded Kigali market.
Begin with one or two partner categories.
Clearly label paid placement; no payment influence on parcel facts, zoning or organic relevance.
Obtain explicit consent before sharing a user's contact information.
Measure search-to-contact, lead validity, partner response, conversions, renewal and contribution margin.
Separate Taiseel development/JV economics and disclose affiliated projects.
Get written partner terms and local legal review for mortgage and transaction-linked referral fees.

fights.crux: When to charge for listings and promotion?
fights.story: The board favoured frictionless basic supply onboarding while inventory is thin; monetise partner outcomes and optional promotion after user demand exists.

fights.crux: What is the first revenue product?
fights.story: No single monetisation fits all partners. Test a narrow agent or developer campaign first, measuring qualified enquiries and renewal.

fights.crux: Can Taiseel remain neutral while having its own projects?
fights.story: Affiliated projects must be disclosed and paid ranking must not secretly alter organic relevance or data.

amendments.amendment: Label paid placement and preserve factual neutrality.
amendments.reason: Protects trust, the core marketplace asset.

amendments.amendment: Define qualified leads and partner response requirements.
Start with one partner segment and one onboarding workflow.
Assign one owner to inventory freshness and search quality.
Stage spending and require renewals and positive contribution.

cheapest_test: Seed one Kigali segment with free verified listings, route consent-based enquiries and then offer a small cohort of agents/developers one clearly priced paid campaign or qualified-lead pilot.
revisit: After the first 90-day marketplace pilot, review active verified inventory, repeat searchers, search-to-contact rate, invalid/duplicate lead rate, response time, partner conversions, renewals and contribution margin.
override_note: GO WITH CONDITIONS because marketplace liquidity, partner monetisation and data trust are not yet evidenced at Taiseel's scale.
